explication: PrivateLM is a Flutter chat and task client that routes user requests to either on-device model inference or cloud AI providers. Its documented flow runs from UI through GetX controllers to inference services, with local models downloaded/imported separately and sessions/settings persisted locally. The README also describes device-based configuration and background/push features. Flutter application sources are absent from the supplied tree, so those nodes have null paths; the native bridge and download/import links are based on the sampled Android files, and other feature links follow the README rather than inspected implementation.
